notes.title: Calling all tentacle fans! "Apprehending the Adventuer Chan! ~Live2D Tentacles Simulator~" is officially released!!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/324ed2f1aa42c9c21c324dce20394bd8a46b02c3.png[/img]

Published by Alice Publication and developed by No.7 Void Mine, the adult tentacle discipline game "Apprehending the Adventuer Chan! ~Live2D Tentacles Simulator~" is now available on Steam as of today (6/28)!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3012420/Live2D/

[h3][b]【Story Summary】[/b][/h3] 
One day, Adventurer-chan takes on a quest from the guild to "investigate the strange dungeon appearing near the forest." After beating up a group of slimes on the way to the dungeon, she is caught off guard, ambushed from behind by tentacles, and dragged back to the dungeon, becoming their plaything... 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/b95404e1493d5c6a7c537a3b4af4936a3142a66a.png[/img]

[h3][b]【Gameplay】[/b][/h3] 
This game is a Live2D simulator filled with tentacles and training. Players can control the tentacles to train Adventurer-chan, earn titles to gain SP, and unlock more diverse gameplay, tentacles, and abnormal statuses using SP! Adventurer-chan reacts to different training operations by the player, with all performances fully animated in Live2D. The game includes over 60 titles and more than 35 abnormal statuses! Additionally, it features a simple paper doll system and an expression editor, allowing players to adjust hair, eyes, body, and accessories, as well as customize Adventurer-chan's expressions based on different events and emotions, ensuring that you can stay true to your ideal fetishes!

[h3][b]【Game Features】[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Full of tentacle training
[*] Complete Live2D animations
[*] Highly customizable character system
[*] Diverse titles and abnormal statuses
[/list]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/3133fe72ed039381e90351f0f7c8dc41756dff92.png[/img]

"Apprehending the Adventuer Chan! ~Live2D Tentacles Simulator~" is a tentacle training simulator designed for gentlemen who love tentacles. It is now available on Steam. Interested players, don't miss out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3012420/Live2D/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2911250/_X__X/
[h3][b][Game Introduction][/b][/h3]

The gameplay combines visual novel elements with light survival and crafting systems. There are six unique female characters who will survive on the island with you. Players need to explore the uninhabited island to collect resources, cook various dishes, and craft tools to aid their survival. You can also invite the female characters to join you in adventures, trade resources with them, and build affection to trigger various wild events!

notes.title: Happy 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41971938/a3691ebac471e5a3bacdfcb11256afef46eea438.jpg[/img]
[h2]Happy 2023![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41971938/8ed64505b89e6fd6610825efe11f7125d6c048ee.png[/img]
[b]STEAM points shop coming soon!
Don’t miss the chance to collect exclusive backgrounds, cards and badges! [/b]

First off we would like to take the chance to thank our players for their continual support. 
We have been extremely humbled by all your honest and helpful feedbacks and suggestions. 



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41971938/e4c15fd30ed2f8ad7ab62eab38df02324f6c937a.png[/img]

We would also like to take this chance to announce that we are in the midst of working on our second adult theme title. These are what you can expect from the upcoming release:

- Relaxing daily girl theme storyline 
- More exploratory and interactive game mechanics
- Twice as much of CG story events 
- Even higher quality Live2D animations 

Players can expect the “Demo version” of this new release to be available in the second half of 2023.
We aspire to allow our players to get a feel of the game style and game contents and we guarantee you would fine the preview really interesting. 

We look forward to receiving more feedbacks and suggestions in the near future and would follow up with the progress made with announcements on our official Twitter account. 

We would strive to work even harder in the year ahead and build a much better team to repay your faith in us. Once again thank you very much for your support!

tags.feature: - More exploratory and interactive game mechanics
- Twice as much of CG story events

notes.title: 【Alice Publication】New HGame《Happiness Double Room》Introduction
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36388466/aef20649d89b6906770573ea375a0dce2bc134c9.png[/img]

Developed by ConnectionGame, the developer of the heart-warming romance game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203970]"The Warmth Between Us"[/url], and published in cooperation with Alice Publication, the practical love-raising interactive game "Happiness Double Room" is scheduled for release in the second half of 2022!

[url]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1897120/[/url]


[url=https://youtu.be/RRt-Rb0Rcew]Game PV[/url] https://youtu.be/RRt-Rb0Rcew
[h1]Story[/h1]

When you are at a low point in your life, that person, the big sister you have never met, appears in front of you.
This time, she will take you, together through the end of the happy summer.


[h1]Game Features[/h1]

[b]◆Easy Interactive System[/b]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36388466/c13b5b9b9d113cab83ed78fb6e68dce3bf815df2.jpg[/img]
No burdens, no worries, enjoy it all is what your sister asks of you!
At the same time, each interaction will have a special contextual atmosphere, and the colorful sister will be visible in your eyes.

In addition, this game supports one-handed operation!

[b]◆Gorgeous and rich lewd animation scene[/b]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36388466/ba9a086473f9874185444eed3440854e34335f36.gif[/img]
12 animated CGs, up to 27 CGs and over 400 CGs including differential changes!

In the sweet little room, various erotic events with your sister will be performed in Live2D, and Minami's voice will be dubbed in Japanese throughout, so there will be no cold scenes!

Each event will have about 10 variations with interactive commands, from "-beep-" to "-beep-", so you can experience it freely!


[b]◆Multiple endings and different choices[/b]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36388466/79255dab6fa61111c3f77815d82981dabf270f31.jpg[/img]

In the end, it's up to you to decide how this period will end. ......
It will be towards a happy future, or as fleeting as a firework?
